title: sayso
gist: Your personal agent can see your Claude Code sessions, gets told when one needs something, and can answer its questions. Commands that look destructive wait for a yes signed on your phone, even with permissions bypassed.
summary: Lets your own agent watch and answer your Claude Code sessions, while risky commands wait for your signature.

hero_image.alt: A Claude Code session asks to run rm -rf data. The agent is told, says it can't approve that, and sends a link. The person holds to approve on their phone and gets a code. The agent passes the code back, and the session runs the command.

site.eyebrow: Claude Code hooks · signed approvals · real binary tests · MIT
site.blurb: A remote control for your Claude Code sessions that your personal agent can hold. Your agent can answer questions and say no, but anything risky waits for a signature from your phone, even with permissions bypassed. It stops a tired model and an injected agent, and it won't stop a session working to get around it.
